function:reject_great_reset_journal_muta.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reject_great_reset_journal_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'GREAT_RESET_JOURNAL_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE = '55000';
END;
$function$

constraint:entries:entries_status_timest.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'ACTIVE'::"EntryStatus") AND ("deletedAt" IS NULL) AND ("hiddenAt" IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'HIDDEN'::"EntryStatus") AND ("deletedAt" IS NULL) AND ("hiddenAt" IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'DELETED'::"EntryStatus") AND ("deletedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("hiddenAt" IS NULL))))

constraint:great_reset_intents:great_res.definition: CHECK (((NOT (("consumedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("invalidatedAt" IS NOT NULL))) AND (("consumedAt" IS NULL) OR (("consumedAt" >= "createdAt") AND ("consumedAt" < "expiresAt"))) AND (("invalidatedAt" IS NULL) OR ("invalidatedAt" >= "createdAt"))))
